pairs.subject: node-boot-and-declarative-bootstrap
pairs.evidence: src/lib/org/security.ts:4 The context is request-time dashboard and API code (a redirect page, a pure assembly module over the db layer, an org-scoped audit read and CSV export, a PDF render), so none of the subject's preconditions hold: no stateful-node boot graph, no reload path, no first-start bootstrap, no seal. A search of the context's own files for SIGHUP, reloadable, restart-only and firstStart found nothing. Two hits are not this subject: the only 'marker' is a once-per-window audit claim, and 'reload' appears in UI copy in a sibling file. Broader terms ('bootstrap', 'seed', 'seal', 'unseal') do hit sibling files in src/lib/db (pglite-boot.ts, control-observations.ts) and src/app/api/audit/verify, but those belong to other contexts (the local-DB boot and the control-ledger seals).

techniques.evidence: src/app/org/[slug]/security/page.tsx:10 The page is a per-request redirect with no startup steps to order; this context has no node boot.
src/lib/db/scans-audit.ts:106 The audit 'marker' is a transactional once-per-window claim for a cron side effect, not a first-start bootstrap of a fresh node.
src/app/api/audit/route.ts:2 The audit trail is a DB table that this API only reads. No audit sink or device is born from configuration that the API could edit.
